opening.argument: The speaker actively solicits participation in BitClub Network by connecting recruitment, payment for equipment, cryptocurrency mining, and extraordinary wealth claims. He says that "joining the network recruiting users would have to make a million dollars per month," presenting recruitment as a path to extreme earnings. He also instructs viewers to "give us money, buy equipment, mine bitcoin or any cryptocurrency and we give it to you," directly tying payment to participation and promised cryptocurrency. The network-marketing activity includes repeated calls and follow-ups, while the speaker adds that "we will be very rich when the coin reaches 10,000." These recruitment demands, payment instructions, and millionaire promises establish an active solicitation built around tiered network expansion rather than neutral discussion.
